children: Overview
Canada family entertainment firm's Q1 revenue from continuing operations rose 1% yr/yr
Adjusted EBITDA for Q1 declined due to lower gross margin in content and licensing agency revenues
Company repurchased 1.0 mln shares under NCIB and 13.8 mln shares via SIB after quarter-end
Outlook
WildBrain reaffirms Fiscal 2027 revenue outlook of C$270 mln to C$295 mln
Company expects Fiscal 2027 Adjusted EBITDA of C$28 mln to C$32 mln
WildBrain anticipates negative Free Cash Flow in Fiscal 2027 due to targeted investments
Result Drivers

OWNED-BRAND LICENSING - Growth in franchise and global licensing revenue was led by higher owned-brand licensing royalties, particularly for Strawberry Shortcake, and increased distribution revenue for Teletubbies

CONTENT MIX SHIFT - Content revenue declined due to lower distribution, music and other revenue, as the prior year benefited from a significant content sale and passive royalties on a partner-brand arrangement that has since ended; partially offset by higher live-action production activity
PLATFORM ADVERTISING - WildBrain Network revenue rose, driven by growth in platform advertising revenue, mainly on FAST and AVOD platforms

GROSS MARGIN PRESSURE - Gross margin declined due to a shift in content revenue mix toward lower-margin production and away from high-margin distribution and partner-brand royalties, and increased franchise marketing investment, partially offset by improved margins in WildBrain Network
